column6: @wDN{Enlil}, the king of all the lands, entrusted @wRN{@wDN{Utu}-ḫeŋal}, the mighty man, the king of @wSN{Unug}, the king of the four quarters, the king whose orders cannot be countermanded, with wiping out the name of @wGN{Gutium}, the fanged snake of the mountains, who acted with violence against the gods, who carried off the kingship of @wGN{Sumer} to foreign lands, who filled @wGN{Sumer} with wickedness, who took away spouses from the married and took away children from parents, who made wickedness and violence normal in the Land.

He went to his lady, @wDN{Inana}, and prayed to her: @q[Utu-hejal,Inana]{“My lady, lioness in the battle, who butts the foreign lands, @wDN{Enlil} has entrusted me with bringing back the kingship to @wGN{Sumer}. May you be my help!”}

The enemy troops established themselves everywere. @wRN{Tirigan}, the king of @wGN{Gutium} …… the mouths of the channels. Nobody came out of his city to face him; he already occupied both banks of the @wWN{Tigris}. In the south, in @wGN{Sumer}, he blocked the water from the fields, in the uplands he closed off the roads. Because of him the grass grew high on the highways of the land.

But the king, endowed with power by @wDN{Enlil}, chosen by @wDN{Inana} with her @vart[t216.v1,t216.v1]{@varn{1 ms. adds:} holy } heart -- @wRN{@wDN{Utu}-ḫeŋal}, the mighty man, came out from @wSN{Unug} to face him and set up camp at the temple of @wDN{Iškur}. He addressed a speech to the citizens of his city: @q[Utu-hejal,citizens of Unug]{“@wDN{Enlil} has given @wGN{Gutium} to me and my lady @wDN{Inana} will be my help! @wDN{Dumuzid-ama-ušumgal-ana} has declared @q[Dumuzid-ama-ucumal-ana,Utu-hejal]{“It is a matter for me!”} and assigned @wDN{Gilgameš}, the son of @wDN{Ninsumun}, to me as a constable!”} The citizens of @wSN{Unug} and @wSN{Kulaba} rejoiced and followed him with one accord. He lined up his élite troops.

After departing from the temple of @wDN{Iškur}, on the fourth day he set up camp in @wSN{Naŋsu} on the @wWN{Surungal} canal, and on the fifth day he set up camp at the shrine at @wSN{Ili-tappê}. He captured @wRN{Ur-@wDN{Ninazu}} and @wRN{Nabi-@wDN{Enlil}}, generals of @wRN{Tirigan} sent as envoys to @wGN{Sumer}, and put them in handcuffs.

After departing from the shrine at @wSN{Ili-tappê}, on the sixth day he set up camp at @wSN{Karkara}. He went to @wDN{Iškur} and prayed to him: @q[Utu-hejal,Ickur]{“O @wDN{Iškur}, @wDN{Enlil} has provided me with weapons, may you be my help!”} In the middle of that night, …… he departed and above @wSN{Adab} he went to the rising @wDN{Utu} and prayed to him: @q[Utu-hejal,Utu]{“O @wDN{Utu}, @wDN{Enlil} has given @wGN{Gutium} to me, may you be my help!”} He laid a trap there behind the Gutian. @wRN{@wDN{Utu}-ḫeŋal}, the mighty man, defeated their generals.

Then @wRN{Tirigan} the king of @wGN{Gutium} ran away alone on foot. He thought himself safe in @wSN{Dabrum}, where he fled to save his life; but since the people of @wSN{Dabrum} knew that @wRN{@wDN{Utu}-ḫeŋal} was a king endowed with power by @wDN{Enlil}, they did not let @wRN{Tirigan} go, and an envoy of @wRN{@wDN{Utu}-ḫeŋal} arrested @wRN{Tirigan} together with his wife and children in @wSN{Dabrum}. He put handcuffs and a blindfold on him. Before @wDN{Utu}, @wRN{@wDN{Utu}-ḫeŋal} made him lie at his feet and placed his foot on his neck. He made @wGN{Gutium}, the fanged snake of the mountains drink again from the crevices, he ……, he …… and he …… boat. He brought back the kingship of @wGN{Sumer}.
